AGENDA  TRAFFIC COMMISSION  CITY OF ROLLING HILLS
Regular Traffic Meeting  Thursday, July 23, 2020  8:30 AM

  This meeting is held pursuant to Executive Order N-29-20 issued by Governor Newsom on
  March17, 2020. All Traffic Commission members will participate by teleconference.

Public Participation: City Hall will be closed for public meeting until further notice. A live audio
 of the Traffic Commission meeting will be available on the City's website (https://www.rolling-
  hills.org/government/agenda/index.php). The meeting agenda is also available on the City's website
  (https://www.rolling-hills.org/government/agenda/index.php).

 Members of the public may submit comments in real time by emailing the City Clerk's office at
 cityclerk@cityofrh.net. Your comments will become a part of the official meeting record. You
  must provide your full name but do not provide any other personal information (i.e., phone
  numbers, addresses, etc) that you do not want to be published.
